rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The President read the notice received from Prime Minister Kan (菅内閣総理大臣) that the Cabinet had decided that day, 30 August 2011, to resign en masse (Diet Act art. 64).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: On the first ballot of 30 August 2011 no one reached the majority of 121 of 241 votes (野田佳彦 110, 谷垣禎一 85, 山口那津男 19, 渡辺喜美 11, 志位和夫 6, 福島みずほ 5, 平沼赳夫 3, 舛添要一 2), so a runoff between 野田佳彦 and 谷垣禎一 was held under House of Councillors Rules art. 20(3).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the runoff of 30 August 2011 the House designated 野田佳彦 as Prime Minister: 110 votes to 谷垣禎一's 107, with 24 blank, of 241. The sitting opened at 13:31 and adjourned at 14:09.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12).
